title: Dealer Compliance Fee Table — Vehicle Purchase Agreements Documentation Fee by Selling Dealer State
content:
**Fee rule.** The documentation fee on an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements is the fee that the documentation fee table sets for the state of the selling Kestrel dealer license, rounded half up to the cent.

**Documentation fee table.** The table is keyed by state and is the same for all six vehicle programs, from Kestrel Value Line to Kestrel Factory Certified.

| State | Table fee |
|---|---|
| Arizona (AZ) | $499.00 |
| Texas (TX) | $225.00 |
| Georgia (GA) | $599.00 |
| Florida (FL) | $999.00 |
| North Carolina (NC) | $699.00 |
| Ohio (OH) | $387.00 |
| Pennsylvania (PA) | $477.00 |
| Colorado (CO) | $699.00 |

**Which state.** The selling Kestrel dealer license state is the state of the hub that holds the vehicle, recorded on the order as the selling dealer state.

**Worked examples (hypothetical orders).**
- A vehicle held at a Texas hub and sold to a buyer living in Florida: $225.00.
- A vehicle held at a Florida hub and sold to a buyer living in Texas: $999.00.
- A vehicle held at an Ohio hub: $387.00, whatever the vehicle program.
